messages:
marta: FYI PR #1824 updates the security & compliance section — legal flagged some absolute wording around log retention. Need a quick docs + SDK snippet sanity check before we merge.

alex: skimmed it. main callout: the SDK example uses `retention: 'never'` which reads like we're telling users to disable retention. probably better to show a realistic TTL example.

jamie: legal-review here. please avoid statements like "we keep audit logs indefinitely". allowed phrasing: "logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies and applicable laws". also suggest adding a note about PII redaction. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I can update the snippet. proposing this change in the code example:
```js
// set retention in SDK client (example)
client.createAuditStream({
  name: 'app-events',
  retention_days: 90, // example; customers can set per-stream TTL
});
```

alex: looks good. also add an inline comment that the platform supports server-side redaction hooks and point to the runbook link.

marta: agreed. can you also add a short migration note for existing customers who had no TTL set? say something like: "Streams without an explicit TTL will inherit account default retention; admin can update via console or API."

kevin: adding that now. question: should we include a tiny oneliner about exportability of audit logs for compliance? legal-review?

legal-review: yes — ok to add: "Audit logs can be exported on-demand for retention and legal holds; contact your account team for assistance." Keep it non-committal about duration.

marta: perfect. also add a short cross-ref to the privacy page (internal runbook) for redaction examples: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-redaction. mark this as a docs PR blocker until the snippet + migration blurb are in.

kevin: pushed patch with snippet + migration blurb + link. triggered CI.

docs-bot: CI checks for PR #1824 passed — 3/3 checks green.

alex: quick editorial nits: remove the word "always" from the example sentence "We always retain audit events" -> "Audit events are retained". otherwise LGTM.

marta: thanks all — I'll merge once kev's patch is in and legal signoff present. tagging @legal-review for final ack. :thumbsup:

legal-review: ack from my side. good to go.

marta: merged. leaving a changelog note under docs release notes about the clearer retention wording and new SDK example.

alex: nice, thanks everyone.
